Title: 3 Foods That Are Secretly Making Your Canker Sores Worse

Description:
Bite into your lunch and feel that same sting hit the same sore spot again? A few everyday foods could be the reason it won't heal.

Citrus fruits, chocolate, and coffee are three of the most common culprits behind canker sores that keep coming back or take forever to heal.

Watch to find out why, and what to swap in instead.
